evd_title: GPT-4 Turbo achieved F1=0.89 and 90% accuracy pooled across 9 CONSORT text questions on held-out clinical trial reports
finding: GPT-4 Turbo achieved F1=0.89 and 90% accuracy pooled across 9 CONSORT text questions on held-out clinical trial reports
P: TEST split (20%) of 113 sports-medicine RCT reports (Schulz et al. 2020), 9 CONSORT text items (198 instances)
I: GPT-4 Turbo (API), zero-shot with engineered prompts, T=0.2, Top P=0.2; paper split into sections
C: Schulz et al. 2020 human CONSORT-adherence labels (ground truth)
O: Pooled F1 0.89, accuracy 90% (85-94%); per-item accuracy 83-100%, F1 0.57-1.00
T: Papers published 2020; model run date not reported; paper 2025
